referenceSources.description:
This rare Jaguar XJ220 C LM, chassis 002, is finished in dark green with Unipart and TWR Racing livery, bearing the number 50 and a British flag on its door. The car’s aerodynamic composite bodywork, large rear wing, and Dunlop-branded front splitter reflect its 1993 24 Hours of Le Mans specification. Sponsor logos from speedline, StenaSealink, XK Engineering, and Snap-on Motorsport adorn the flanks, while lightweight racing wheels complete the track-focused appearance.

One of only four bespoke XJ220 C race chassis built, this example retains its original features from its Le Mans debut, where it was driven by David Brabham, John Nielsen, and David Coulthard to a class victory before disqualification. Formerly owned by the Sultan of Brunei and later part of a UK private collection, the car has since appeared at historic events like the Goodwood Festival of Speed and remains eligible for GT1 and endurance racing series.
